keyword: uconn vs michigan where to watch
claims: The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship between UConn and Michigan tips off on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 8:50 p.m. ET.
The 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship between UConn and Michigan will air on TBS, TNT, and truTV.
Live streaming options include HBO Max, Sling TV, DirecTV Stream, YouTube TV, and Hulu + Live TV.
HBO Max is available on the Standard plan (ad-free).
Sling TV offers a $4.99 "Day Pass" to watch TBS/TNT.
Sling TV offers access via the Sling Orange package.
DirecTV Stream features a 5-day free trial for new users.
Hulu + Live TV includes a 3-day free trial.
YouTube TV offers a free trial option for new subscribers.
